FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Shutter & Frame Camera Supply, we operate as a premier retail camera and photo supply store dedicated to providing photographers of all skill levels with high-quality equipment and personalized service. Our inventory primarily consists of cameras, lenses, accessories, and standard studio lighting, with a commitment to keeping our total inventory value under $500,000 to manage risk effectively. Our knowledgeable sales associates, including experienced photographers, assist customers in selecting the right products to meet their needs. In addition to in-store sales, we offer e-commerce shopping for added convenience. We also host photography workshops in our store, allowing customers to learn and enhance their skills in a safe environment that adheres strictly to local business licensing regulations. With a focus on customer satisfaction and continual inventory assessments, we ensure that our operations run smoothly while providing a secure shopping experience.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss on 06/15/2023 due to theft of camera equipment valued at $1,000; reported to police and insurance; claim status: settled. Loss on 09/10/2023 due to water damage from a leaking roof affecting inventory, amounting to $500; claim under review.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secured Class II Safe, UL Listed, Rated for Cash and Valuables up to $50,000
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard monitoring during business hours.
